portion_doctrine: Segments 91-100 of 'new hot shit' document are video transcript content, primarily interview dialogue from Piers Morgan and Lex Fridman conversations with Kanye West. Not a structured operating document. Transcript format: timestamp (HH:MM:SS) + dialogue lines. No formal methods, operating rules, tactics, or named systems present in this portion. Only anecdotal narrative content.
gold_content: Sunday Service format: expository preaching (word-by-word biblical exegesis), choir-based, community gathering model (no ask, reframes church as event worth attending)
Donda design company structure: manifests abstract ideas into tangible products/experiences; employed heads of major fashion houses (Virgil to LV, Givenchy leads)

Monastery + fully-sustainable community vision: hydroponic vertical farming 'A-to-Z' self-sufficiency, water-based energy systems (aqueduct model from Masada), solar rejection in favor of mirror/steam-engine water loops
Gospel university concept: 200,000-seat circular stadium with 100,000 gospel singers; trained like Olympic athletes; compares to soccer chants/stadium collective energy
Education core: physics as anchor discipline; real-world education (not dumbed-down kids versions); post-pandemic resilience framing
Deconstruction philosophy: breaks apart systems (music contracts, city design, religious services) and reimagines them without abandoning utility
Faith vs. confidence/arrogance shift: confidence when knowing what to do, arrogance when not; moved from arrogance to faith; faith defined as opposite of fear
Music industry critique: contracts designed to 'rape the artist' (his term); 10-contract labyrinth; distribution partner model as unnecessary middleman; artists lose masters systematically
Record label leverage: artists sign away distribution in exchange for upfront capital; parallel to geopolitical power dynamics (nations losing sovereignty for aid)
Medication critique: claims psychiatric drugs were attempt to suppress his visionary capacity and confidence; fluoride in toothpaste/deodorants framed as pineal gland blockers
Trump election precedent: cited 2016 election as proof outsider can win; positioned himself as non-politician with visionary mandate
Systemic racism frame: white supremacy embedded in American systems; narrative control (Marvel's Black Panther designed by white creators for Black audience); programming via education/media
Money as non-reality: wealth isn't backed by anything; relationships as higher-value currency than capital; mastery of systems requires understanding their emptiness
Lineage framing: 'billionaire by 2025' confidence rooted in childhood poverty + later financial success; debt used to prove resilience/recovery capacity
Calling narrative: God/higher power as source of direction; distinguishes service (to deity/humanity) from ego-driven ambition; Sunday Service as test of sustained ministry commitment

specific_tactics: Sunday Service weekly commitment: locked schedule creates ritual; no ask from attendees; entertainment + spirituality fusion
Contract visibility: post contracts publicly on Twitter; expose industry norms; invite deconstruction
Community design: 300-acre property model + monastery build = proof-of-concept for sustainable living systems
Expository preaching preference: word-by-word biblical grounding avoids interpretation variance; matches his production philosophy (sauce on the word = unnecessary)
Stadium-scale event design: use Olympics/soccer models (60k-person chants); 100k choir as collective voice phenomenon
Deconstruction as rhetoric: break down system -> acknowledge it's broken -> rebuild via innovation (applies to music, city design, church, education)
contradictions: Claims music industry losing him $4M annually but built entire career in music; framed as sacrifice for larger ideological work vs. retreat from industry
Rejects solar panels (Edison's ideas) in favor of Tesla/water systems, but then acknowledges engineer's steam-engine + mirror solution uses same physics principle he initially rejected
Positions himself as confidently knowing future (billionaire by 2025, presidency viable) while also claiming exhaustion/meditation-need that led to hospitalization
Criticizes Black History Month as demoralizing/programming, yet uses 'second wealthiest Black man in America' as credibility marker (contradiction in frame application)
weird_gold: King Koopa holding Kim in Mario Brothers castle as metaphor for separation dynamics; cycles of rescue/recapture as game structure
Fluoride/deodorant as pharmaceutical/psychological suppression vectors; pineal gland as the target (spiritual/perception organ)
Masada aqueduct system as ancient proof-of-concept for sustainable city water loops; ties to monastery build plans
Pastor Adam's son's mouth-of-babes request ('hear Jesus rap album') as decision-making heuristic: listen to children's wisdom over programmed adults
Donda as cybernetic extension of brain; manifests thought-without-touch into physical reality; references Incredibles/Edna as design metaphor
Faith defined as opposite of fear; confidence when knowing, arrogance when not; arrogance chosen over diminishment = hope/survival logic
Titanic metaphor: people prefer going down with ship (protecting status dress) over lifeboat (losing class appearance); civilization in final stages of sinking
Money is not real but keeps poor poor/rich rich via structural perpetuation; system designed for hierarchy, not happiness
